description_en: Queries the list of available parameter templates
description_zh: 查询可用的参数模版列表
kebab_example: aliyun r-kvstore describe-parameter-groups --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --db-type redis --engine-version example-string --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeParameterGroups

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473763.html to query the region ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The engine type. Valid values:
redis: Redis Community Edition or Tair (Enhanced Edition) in-memory type.
tair_pena: Tair (Enhanced Edition) persistent memory type.
tair_pdb: Tair (Enhanced Edition) cloud disk type (ESSD/SSD)
